_doc: English tells for wdym triage. Every pattern is a JavaScript regex compiled case-insensitive. Weights add up to an ambiguity score; anchors subtract. A pack (references/packs.md) can add tells, verdict words, classes and readings on top of these.

type.explain: ^\s*(wdym|wym|what do you mean|what did you mean)\b
type.wondering: ^\s*(?:hey\s+|so\s+|ok(?:ay)?\s+|hmm+\s+|wait\s+)?(why|what|how|when|where|who|whose|is|are|was|were|(?:do|did)\s+(?:you|we|i|they)\b|does\s+(?:it|this|that|the|he|she|anyone)\b|has|have|explain|im just wondering|i'm just wondering|just wondering|curious|is there|are there)\b
type.deciding: \b(should (?:we|i)|which (?:one|is|should|would)|what do you think|wdyt|thoughts\?|\bvs\.?\b|versus|or should|better to|pick (?:one|between)|would you recommend|do you recommend)\b
type.building: \b(build|make|create|add|fix|change|update|remove|delete|implement|write|refactor|deploy|ship|set ?up|install|move|rename|design|redesign|edit|convert|generate|run|let'?s|lets|do it|start|finish|publish|post|send|clean ?up|improve|optimi[sz]e|i want|i need|we need|can you|could you|please|go ahead)\b

tells.re: \b(you know what i mean|u know what i mean|ykwim|if you know what i mean|you get me|you know the vibe|you know the one)\b

\b(make it better|better|improve|nicer|cleaner|clean it up|premium|polish(?:ed)?|optimi[sz]e|upgrade|level up|make it pop|pop more|modern(?:ize)?|sleek|more professional|fancier|cooler|more (?:alive|dynamic|engaging|fun|interesting)|enhance|fix it|make it work|looks? off|feels? off|not quite right|something'?s off|spice it up)\b
\b(that one|the one (?:we|you|i)|like before|like last time|same as (?:before|last time)|as you know|remember (?:the|that|when|how)|the thing|that thing|do it again|like we did|you know which)\b
\b(like that|kinda like|kind of like|something like|similar to|in the style of|the vibe of|the feel of|same vibe)\b

tells.computed: a building prompt of 6 words or fewer whose only object is it, this, that or them, with no anchor
over 120 words with 3 or more separate asks (also, and also, plus, then, another thing)
a building prompt with no acceptance words and no anchor

delegate: \b(up to you|your call|you decide|whatever you think|surprise me|dealer'?s choice|you choose|you pick)\b

verdict.miss: \b(i meant|that'?s not what i|not what i (?:meant|asked|wanted|said)|you misunderstood|misunderstood|wrong (?:one|thing|file|page|section|part)|not that one|i said|i asked for|i didn'?t ask|i did not ask|no,? i (?:want|need|meant)|not like that|that'?s not it|you got it wrong|read (?:it|my message) again)\b
verdict.broken: \b(still (?:broken|not working|failing|wrong)|not working|doesn'?t work|does not work|not done|you said (?:it was )?done|that'?s wrong|it'?s broken|crash(?:es|ed)?)\b

coach.ykwim: Say which picture you mean: paste a link or screenshot, or name the file.
coach.i-mean: Restate it as one sentence that starts with the result you want.
coach.vague-goal: Replace 'better' with what better means: a number, a reference, or 'done when ...'.
coach.dangling: Name the thing: the file, the link, or the date it happened.
coach.like-that: Say which part of the reference you like, and what stays the same.
coach.described-look: Describe the look, then let wdym show you the named options to tap.
coach.short-vague: Add the object: what should change, and where.
coach.dump: Lead with the one result that matters most, then list the rest.
coach.no-done: End with one 'done when' line so the agent knows when to stop.
